description: Verify a list of US addresses in one request. Each address is an object with primary_line, city, state, zip_code (secondary_line/recipient optional). Returns per-address deliverability + corrected components. Example: lob_verify_bulk({ addresses: [{ primary_line: "210 King St", city: "San Francisco", state: "CA", zip_code: "94107" }], _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Lob API key (sign up at https://dashboard.lob.com/).

addresses.description: Array of address objects, each with primary_line, city, state, zip_code (secondary_line, recipient, urbanization optional).

name: lob_verify_bulk
title: Lob Verify Bulk
